sourceProfile.mode: forward with stochastic sampling in train and eval

sourceFacts: Encoder convolutions use kernels 6/4/2, strides 2/2/2, zero padding, and channels 16/32/64; 28->12->5->2 spatial sizes.
Two independent Linear(256,latent) posterior heads each call x.view(-1,64*2*2); no intermediate hidden latent hierarchy exists.
Internal epsilon is randn(B,latent).to(module global device); z=mu+epsilon*exp(logvar/2) with no train/eval gate.
randn dimensions read z_mu.size(0/1); mu->epsilon is a shape dependency only, not a feature-value input.
encoder returns (mu,logvar,encoded), and forward returns (mu,logvar,encoded,decoded); decoder receives selected z.
Decoder Linear projects to 256 before reshape to 64x2x2; transposed convolutions use (k,s,p)=(2,2,0),(4,3,1),(6,3,4).
Decoder spatial sizes are 2->4->11->28; LeakyReLU follows all three transposed convolutions, then Sigmoid.
All six convolution calls use default bias=True; all six LeakyReLU calls use API default negative_slope=0.01; no BatchNorm or Dropout.
num_features constructor argument is unused; source fixes posterior/decoder base map at 64x2x2.
Losses, label-map reconstruction targets and standalone random decoder calls belong to notebook caller cells, outside forward.
Encoder one-hot labels broadcast to 10 constant spatial maps and concatenate with the image before Conv2d(11,16).
Decoder calls to_onehot again and concatenates 50 latent entries with 10 label entries before Linear(60,256).
Final decoder ConvTranspose2d outputs 11 hard-coded channels, not a one-channel image; training BCE reconstructs augmented image+label maps.
Only visualization slices decoded[:,0]; forward returns all 11 channels, with no label inference or Softmax head.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed

semantic.label: MNIST grayscale image
detail: Caller ToTensor scales pixels to [0,1]; input is not flattened

semantic.label: Concat image + label channels
detail: torch.cat((features,ones),dim=1)
Condition enters BEFORE enc_conv_1

semantic.label: Independent posterior heads
detail: Logical head-result group; no source tuple is created at this point

semantic.label: Reparameterization / single latent
detail: No training/eval conditional; sampling always runs

semantic.label: Return (mu, logvar, z)
detail: Actual encoder return tuple; no feature concatenation

semantic.label: Select encoded z from tuple
detail: Decoder receives only encoded, plus targets in conditional variant

semantic.label: Concat z + one-hot labels
detail: torch.cat((encoded,onehot_targets),dim=1)
Condition enters BEFORE dec_linear_1

semantic.label: Sigmoid decoded pixels
detail: Follows final LeakyReLU, not the raw final convolution

semantic.label: Return (mu, logvar, z, decoded)
detail: Actual four-field forward return; no image-only implicit output

semantic.label: Internal Gaussian epsilon
detail: torch.randn(z_mu.size(0),z_mu.size(1)).to(device)
Created inside reparameterize in train and eval

semantic.label: External MNIST class labels
detail: Integer digit labels 0...9; supplied to BOTH encoder and decoder
